name: Can laminate or thermofoil cabinets be painted as well as real wood?

mainEntity.name: Can laminate or thermofoil cabinets be painted as well as real wood?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, laminate, thermofoil, and composite cabinets can be painted successfully, provided the underlying core material remains firmly bonded and free of swelling. The key difference lies in the prep work: slick laminate and vinyl surfaces lack natural wood pores, so they require thorough degreasing, mechanical scuff-sanding, and a heavy-duty bonding primer formulated specifically to adhere to non-porous plastics. If thermofoil is already peeling away from the underlying medium-density fiberboard, the loose coating must be repaired or removed before any paint can be applied.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but they require specialized bonding primers and scuff-sanding to adhere to smooth, non-porous surfaces. Any peeling thermofoil must be addressed prior to painting.
